slices.focus: Nadia's personal introduction: life story, work at Journey's End, family, and long-term resettlement capacity goals.
slices.summary: Nadia introduces herself as a 34-year-old casework supervisor at Journey's End Refugee Services in Buffalo, NY. She describes her INFJ personality, her path from case manager to supervisor, her long-term goal of building a durable intake system, and her personal life: fiance Omar (respiratory therapist), sister Leila (SUNY Geneseo), living above aunt Maha's tailoring shop, and financial constraints.
